title: Executive summary — Las Vegas Strip single-entry tournament trip planner
scope: Venetian DSE IV (Nov 16 – Dec 23, 2026), Wynn WPT World Championship (Nov 27 – Dec 21, 2026) and Wynn/Caesars/MGM recurring dailies. Every Venetian structure sheet (1–37) and the full WPT structures document were read first-hand on 2026-11-16. Values appear only where an official source states them.

headline.label: Sheet-silent single-entry candidates (Venetian DSE IV)
headline.note: Structure sheets read in full; no re-entry/rebuy/add-on clauses anywhere on the sheet — candidates under the strict standard (explicit single-entry confirmation outstanding). Includes 3 bounty types and 1 PKO, labeled separately.

headline.note: Includes all 12 WPT event types with published terms (all allow re-entry), 4 Wynn dailies, 8 Venetian multi-flights, 7 satellites, 1 team event, Caesars add-on and MGM loyalty events.

findings.title: Single-entry confirmation is now sheet-level
findings.text: All 37 Venetian DSE IV structure sheets were read in full. 46 one-day (plus one two-day) events contain no re-entry, re-buy or add-on clause anywhere on the sheet. Under the strict standard adopted on main (arena/e1c079dc-poker2: sheet silence is not confirmation) these are single-entry CANDIDATES — the sheets' one-buy-in accounting supports it, but written single-entry confirmation from the poker room is still outstanding. The two Valuetown events are held back on their 'subsequent buy in's' wording.

findings.title: Wynn WPT is a re-entry series
findings.text: Every WPT event whose terms are published in the official structures document allows re-entry (unlimited per flight until level 9–10, or one re-entry per flight for WPT Prime). The 12 documented event types are excluded from the single-entry list. 33 schedule rows have no published terms and stay unverified.

findings.title: Value ranking (descriptive ratio)
findings.text: Ranked by guarantee ÷ buy-in among sheet-silent candidates with a printed guarantee: Event 36 $800 bounty $75K (93.75×), Event 54 $600 bounty $50K (83.33×), Event 52 $1,100 PKO $75K (68.18×). Bounty guarantees include bounty money — read the ratio as description, not EV.

findings.title: Plan one seat per day, evenings conditional
findings.text: For Dec 6–13 the plan gives each day a primary confirmed event and, where a second exists, a conditional evening fallback. 1-Day events run to a winner, so back-to-back seats are flagged as overlapping.

findings.title: Walkability
findings.text: Venetian/Palazzo are on-site for DSE IV. Harrah's/LINQ/Flamingo/Cromwell are 9–17 min from the Venetian. Wynn/Encore guests are 0–13 min from the WPT room (in Encore). Golden Nugget (83 min), Westgate (39 min), Mandalay Bay (52 min) fail the 30-minute rule to the Venetian.

findings.title: Hotel economics
findings.text: Verified: Venetian/Palazzo/Wynn/Encore resort fee $55+tax; MGM Grand $50+tax; ARIA/Bellagio $55+tax; conditional Venetian poker rates from $119/$209 per night; 13.38% room tax; Venetian parking $20/day. Not verified: dated room quotes, cancellation deadlines, parking elsewhere — all blank and flagged.
